Boundaries.Name: collection-scan-enumeration
Boundaries.Contract: Own count validation and key mapping before the first page. Page sends transfer to their dispatch owner. Early enumeration disposal is successful; cancellation between yielded items has its own final boundary.

Boundaries.Name: collection-scan-page
Boundaries.Contract: Establish the owner before cancellation and argument construction. Replica affinity, reroutes, cursor and item conversion, and reply disposal borrow the same failure-only owner.

Boundaries.Name: scan-enumerator-cancellation
Boundaries.Contract: Own iterator cancellation outside a pending page. Preserve the original token and rent an error lease only when cancellation throws.
